prompt: Sit in a room full of strangers and say out loud what the noise is actually made of. Cutlery, chair legs, one laugh.

rubric.ideal: There is a coffee machine screaming every couple of minutes, cups going down on saucers, chairs dragging, and about six conversations underneath all of it.
One laugh is louder than everything else in here and it goes off roughly every thirty seconds.
Nobody is playing music and there is no traffic through the glass, so the whole sound is made of people.
